# Test GOCACHE size tracking, cache.log, and 'go clean -cache' under GOEXPERIMENT=trimbuildcache.
[!compiler:gc] skip 'requires the gc toolchain'
[GODEBUG:gocacheverify=1] skip 'gocacheverify skips cache reads, so builds are never warm'
[GOOS:js] skip 'file locking not supported on js'
[GOOS:wasip1] skip 'file locking not supported on wasip1'
env ORIG_GOEXPERIMENT=$GOEXPERIMENT
env GOEXPERIMENT=$ORIG_GOEXPERIMENT,trimbuildcache
env GOCACHE=$WORK/cache

# Cold build records size.txt and cache.log. Warm build and 'clean -cache -n' leave them unchanged.
go build -o $WORK/p.a p.go
exists $GOCACHE/trim.txt
grep -count=1 '^estimated [1-9][0-9]*$' $GOCACHE/size.txt
grep -count=1 ' trim: (24h|low disk) trigger: .* removed [0-9]+ of [0-9]+ files' $GOCACHE/cache.log
cp $GOCACHE/size.txt $WORK/size.txt
cp $GOCACHE/cache.log $WORK/log.txt
go build -o $WORK/p.a p.go
cmp $GOCACHE/size.txt $WORK/size.txt
cmp $GOCACHE/cache.log $WORK/log.txt
go clean -cache -n
exists $GOCACHE/00
cmp $GOCACHE/size.txt $WORK/size.txt
cmp $GOCACHE/cache.log $WORK/log.txt

# 'go clean -cache' clears entries, zeroes size.txt, truncates trim.txt,
# appends clean -cache, and keeps rotated logs. A nonexistent directory is untouched.
cp $WORK/log.txt $GOCACHE/cache.1.log
cp $WORK/log.txt $GOCACHE/cache.2.log
go clean -cache
! exists $GOCACHE/00
grep -count=1 '^estimated 0$' $GOCACHE/size.txt
! grep . $GOCACHE/trim.txt
grep -count=2 '^.' $GOCACHE/cache.log
grep -count=1 ' clean -cache$' $GOCACHE/cache.log
cmp $GOCACHE/cache.1.log $WORK/log.txt
cmp $GOCACHE/cache.2.log $WORK/log.txt
env GOCACHE=$WORK/nonexistent
go clean -cache
! exists $WORK/nonexistent

# With notrimbuildcache, size.txt and cache.log are not created and clean leaves trim.txt alone.
env GOEXPERIMENT=$ORIG_GOEXPERIMENT,notrimbuildcache
env GOCACHE=$WORK/cache_noexp
go build -o $WORK/p2.a p.go
exists $GOCACHE/trim.txt
! exists $GOCACHE/size.txt
! exists $GOCACHE/cache.log
cp $GOCACHE/trim.txt $WORK/trim.txt
go clean -cache
cmp $GOCACHE/trim.txt $WORK/trim.txt
! exists $GOCACHE/cache.log
-- p.go --
package p
